description: Snowflake semantic view YAML over CSA.TJ retail star (6 tables, 5 top-level relationships, facts but no metrics) through the bundled semantic-tools engine. Spec-compliant copy of the legacy fixture whose in-table relationships the engine flags as UNRECOGNIZED_YAML_KEY.
